sections.brief: The Holy See's rules on clerical sexual abuse 1922-2026: Crimen sollicitationis (1922, 1962) secrecy and its scope with both readings; SST and the CDF letter of 18 May 2001 (pontifical secret); 2010 guide and norms (civil law to be followed); rescript of 17 December 2019 abolishing the pontifical secret; Vos estis 2019/2023; Book VI 2021; the Commission for the Protection of Minors, its 2024 and 2025 reports and 2026 statutes. Figures: fig-time

Nine national reports, each with commissioner, method, period and scope, never summed: John Jay 2004, Pennsylvania 2018, Ireland (Ferns, Ryan, Murphy, Cloyne with Kenny and the Holy See's reply), Australia 2017 (7% and method), Germany MHG 2018, France CIASE 2021 (survey, lay staff, method dispute), Portugal, Spain, Switzerland 2023. Figures: fig-compare (reports and methods)

Named cases and Rome's decisions: Law 2002, Maciel 2006/2010, McCarrick report 2020, Chile 2018 resignations, Benedict and the Munich report 2022; US costs and 44 chapter 11 filings as of March 2026; sovereign-immunity limits (link vt5_recognition). Figures: fig-time, fig-stats

Comparators from their own reports: IICSA Anglican 2020 and final 2022; Makin review and Welby resignation 2024; SBC Guidepost 2022; Australian Royal Commission across denominations 2017; EKD ForuM 2024; what the comparison does and does not show. Figures: fig-compare
